title: Preparing your network for the Excel Add-In

facts.text: Excel add-in requires network access to four Microsoft services for functioning and synchronizing data with Business Central.
Network services must allow routing to az689774.vo.msecnd.net, dc.services.visualstudio.com, exceladdinprovider.smb.dynamics.com, and api.businesscentral.dynamics.com.
Custom vertical solution environments use different API endpoints based on ApplicationName.api.bc.dynamics.com format, checkable in Business Central Administration Center.
